hero.title: Agents and automations that take repetitive work off your team's plate.
hero.promise: Most companies don't need "more AI" — they need to know which processes to automate first and to see one running end to end. That's exactly what we do: an honest assessment, a measurable pilot, and, when it makes sense, ongoing operation.

items.title: AI opportunity assessment
items.body: A 2-week diagnostic: we map your processes and prioritize where automation actually pays.

items.title: AI agents
items.body: Assistants that read email, classify requests, draft responses, and execute tasks inside your systems.

items.title: Chatbots on your knowledge
items.body: Customer and internal support with answers grounded in your documents and policies — not made up.

items.title: Process automation
items.body: Flows across your tools — invoicing, CRM, inventory, reporting — without copy-pasting between screens.

items.title: Integration with your systems
items.body: We connect AI to Microsoft 365, Odoo, HubSpot, or your ERP through APIs, with permissions and auditing.

items.title: Measurement and control
items.body: Every automation ships with usage, cost, and error-rate metrics. If it can't be measured, it doesn't ship.

how.caption: Two real flows, on the two channels your customers already use: WhatsApp and the chat on your own site. The assistant understands, answers in seconds, and performs the action — book it, log it, bring in a person — without pulling the customer out of the conversation.

tiers.name: AI Opportunity Assessment
tiers.blurb: Fixed-scope, 2-week diagnostic: process map, use cases ranked by return, and an automation roadmap ready to execute.

tiers.name: Automation Pilot
tiers.blurb: One process automated end to end, in production, with metrics. Concrete proof that this works in your operation.

tiers.name: AI Partner
tiers.blurb: Monthly retainer: we build and operate your agents and automations, with continuous improvements and support.

items.q: Is my company too small for AI?
items.a: If your team does repetitive computer work — answering similar emails, moving data between systems, assembling reports — there's a use case. Size matters less than the volume of repeatable work; the assessment tells you whether the return justifies the investment.

items.q: What about the confidentiality of my data?
items.a: We define from day one which data may leave your company and which may not. We use business accounts with no-training agreements, and when the case demands it, models deployed in your own cloud.
It does — which is why every flow includes human approval points where errors are costly, and visible error-rate metrics. We automate the fault-tolerant, low-risk work first.

items.q: How fast do we see results?
items.a: The assessment takes 2 weeks. A typical pilot is in production 3 to 6 weeks later. You should see hours recovered in the chosen process within the first month.

hero.title: Real security, and a clear path to SOC 2 / PCI DSS.
hero.promise: No fear-selling, no empty checklists: we harden your infrastructure, manage vulnerabilities continuously, and — when your customers demand certifications — take you all the way to the audit with real evidence.

items.title: Infrastructure hardening
items.body: Secure configuration of servers, endpoints, Microsoft 365, and network: MFA, encryption, least privilege, and documented baselines.

items.title: Vulnerability management
items.body: Periodic scanning, risk-based prioritization, and verified remediation — a continuous cycle, not an annual PDF.

items.title: SOC 2 / PCI DSS readiness
items.body: Gap assessment, remediation plan, and evidence support until you pass the audit.

items.title: Identity & email protection
items.body: The entry point for 90% of attacks — phishing, compromised accounts, misconfigured access — closed.

items.title: Incident response
items.body: A tested plan for when something happens: containment, communication, and recovery without improvising.

items.title: Security awareness
items.body: Short, recurring training for your people, because the best firewall doesn't fix a hasty click.

how.caption: A real review: every control with its status and its evidence, climbing to 100%. This is how a prepared company walks into an audit.

tiers.name: Security Baseline
tiers.blurb: Infrastructure hardening, vulnerability scan, and an executive report with clear priorities. The starting point.

tiers.name: SOC 2 / PCI DSS Readiness
tiers.blurb: Gap assessment against the standard, remediation plan, and evidence support through the audit.

tiers.name: vCISO
tiers.blurb: Security as an ongoing function: risk management, periodic reviews, and a security lead without a full-time hire.

items.q: Would anyone really attack a company my size?
items.a: Mass attacks don't pick victims: they scan the internet and exploit whatever is open. SMBs are the most frequent target precisely because they tend to be less protected.

items.q: How long does SOC 2 or PCI DSS readiness take?
items.a: It depends on the starting point; typically 3 to 6 months from gap assessment to audit-ready. The initial assessment gives you an honest timeline within the first week.
No — the audit is always performed by an independent third party. We prepare your infrastructure, policies, and evidence so you walk into that audit to pass it, not to discover problems.
It costs a fraction of what an incident does: the ransom, the days down, the customers lost. We start with the baseline — the essentials done right — and grow from there based on your actual risk.

hero.title: Software that fits your operation, not the other way around.
hero.promise: When the spreadsheet can't take any more and off-the-shelf software forces you to work its way, we build the exact tool: web applications, APIs, and integrations that talk to what you already use.

items.title: Web applications
items.body: Internal portals, operations dashboards, and customer tools built in React and Next.js — fast and easy to use.

items.title: APIs & backends
items.body: Services in FastAPI and Node: solid, documented, and ready to grow with your operation.

items.title: Integrations
items.body: Your systems talking to each other — ERP, CRM, billing, logistics — without manual reconciliation in Excel.

items.title: System modernization
items.body: That old system everyone depends on and nobody wants to touch: we migrate it piece by piece, without stopping the operation.

items.title: AI-enabled software
items.body: Smart search, automatic classification, or assistants inside your own tool — where they add value.

items.title: Operation & evolution
items.body: We don't deliver and disappear: we monitor, fix, and evolve the software on a monthly retainer.

how.caption: How we build: a person sets the goal, an orchestrator decomposes it and delegates to specialised agents working in parallel, and nothing merges without human approval.

tiers.name: Discovery Sprint
tiers.blurb: Fixed price: we understand the problem, prototype the solution, and deliver a plan with scope and budget. You decide on facts.

tiers.name: Project
tiers.blurb: Defined-scope build with biweekly milestones and working demos — you see real progress, not progress reports.

tiers.name: Evolution Retainer
tiers.blurb: Monthly hours to operate, improve, and extend your software with the same team that built it.

items.q: Why not just buy off-the-shelf software?
items.a: If a market product solves your case, we'll tell you — it's cheaper, and we'll implement it. Building custom makes sense when your process is your competitive edge, or when the generic tool forces you to deform your operation.

items.q: How do I know it won't become a never-ending project?
items.a: The discovery sprint defines scope and budget before serious code gets written, and the project moves in biweekly milestones with working demos. If something drifts, you see it in two weeks — not six months.
Yes. All code, documentation, and access are in your name from day one. If you want to work with another team tomorrow, you take everything with you.
Software needs operation: dependencies to update, bugs to fix, improvements to prioritize. That's what the evolution retainer is for — or we train your team to run it.

hero.title: Two surnames, one firm.
hero.intro: Novieri is born from the fusion of its two founders' surnames. It is, literally, a company with its own name: family-run in how it treats you, enterprise in its standards.

story.title: The story
story.body: After 10+ years leading technology for operations of more than 1,000 people (infrastructure, security, PCI DSS and SOC 2 compliance, and AI systems put to work on real production outcomes) and as many years owning client relationships in banking and at one of the world's largest CRM platforms, we kept seeing the same pattern: the enterprise standard exists, but it arrives with a multinational price tag. Novieri exists to close that gap: solutions and services built to the same standards we ran in corporate, at a fraction of what the market charges. This isn't a stripped-down tier for mid-sized companies; it's the same level of practice, delivered by our own team in Barranquilla, without the layers of middlemen that inflate the invoice.

helgar.name: Helgar Palmieri
helgar.bio: Solutions architect and AI engineer with 12+ years shipping production systems. Today CTO of a 24/7 multinational BPO, where he personally architects and writes the AI and integration stack: internal copilots, RAG tooling, workflow automation, and full-stack products. Previously led IT for a PCI DSS-compliant call center. MBA.

partner.name: Sylvana Nova
partner.bio: Customer Success Manager at HubSpot and a business administration graduate, with 10+ years in client relationships: understanding the business, driving adoption, and keeping accounts healthy over time. Previously a commercial advisor at Bancolombia. At Novieri she owns the relationship end to end — the proposal, the follow-through, and making sure what we ship actually gets used.

hero.promise: Matter Flow is Novieri's observability platform: a cloud control plane, a network collector for what the cloud can't reach, and a lightweight agent on your hosts. Network devices, internet-link quality, metrics, alerts, and live dashboards — multi-tenant from its first line of code.

features.title: Collector + agent, no open ports
features.body: Both binaries dial out only — firewall-friendly — and when the connection drops they buffer to disk and replay without duplicates on reconnect.

features.title: Network device monitoring
features.body: Switches, firewalls, and SNMP equipment polled by the collector, with an interface inventory that refreshes itself.

features.title: Per-path ISP quality
features.body: Hop-by-hop ICMP probing from every agent: latency, loss, and quality classification — the evidence for claims against your provider.

features.title: Alerts that arrive
features.body: A continuous evaluation engine with states and events, and notification delivery that's verified — not just sent.

features.title: Live dashboards
features.body: A web console with WebSocket updates — no refreshing the page to find out whether something is down.

features.title: Genuinely multi-tenant
features.body: Every metric and every row carries its tenant; every new endpoint is tested against cross-tenant leaks before it exists.

built.title: Platform engineering, tests first.
built.body: A FastAPI control plane with Celery workers, Go agent and collector, metrics in VictoriaMetrics, a React console with its own design system — and a testing discipline where the quality classifier runs identically in Go and TypeScript against the same golden cases.

monitoring.name: Networks & Systems Monitoring
monitoring.tagline: 24/7 managed monitoring of networks, servers, and ISPs — operated by Novieri.

hero.title: See your infrastructure the way a NOC does.
hero.promise: An observability platform in three pieces: a cloud control plane, a network collector that watches what the cloud can't reach — SNMP, hosts, databases — and a lightweight agent that also measures your internet links' quality, hop by hop and per carrier.

features.title: Network devices
features.body: Switches, firewalls, UPS units, and controllers monitored over SNMP and ICMP, with assisted discovery and clear states: up, warning, critical, down.

features.title: Per-path ISP quality
features.body: Hop-by-hop latency and packet loss, grouped by carrier — hard evidence for claims against your provider, PingPlotter-style.

features.title: Servers and databases
features.body: Metrics from Windows and Linux hosts and your database engines, collected by the same agent.

features.title: Alerts with judgment
features.body: Severity-based rules with hysteresis — no alert storms — and notification to email, Slack, or Teams.

features.title: Live dashboards
features.body: A NOC-style summary with states, availability, and hardware health; per-domain dashboards for network, clouds, and databases.

features.title: Quality reports
features.body: PDF network-suitability reports — for remote desktop, VoIP, or web — by site, city, and carrier.

built.title: A service, with our own platform underneath.
built.body: Novieri's managed monitoring runs on Matter Flow, our observability platform: an outbound-only collector and agent, time-series metrics, hysteresis-based alerting, and live dashboards. You get the service; we operate the platform.

sentinel.name: Sentinel — Vulnerability Management
sentinel.tagline: Discover, detect, prioritize with AI, and prove progress — on your own network.

hero.title: Know your vulnerabilities before someone else finds them.
hero.promise: A self-hosted vulnerability-management dashboard: it discovers the assets on your network, scans them with established engines in safe mode, joins findings with live threat intelligence, and uses AI to prioritize and explain — in plain language — what to fix first and how.

features.title: Asset discovery
features.body: A continuous inventory of what actually lives on your network — only within authorized scope, guaranteed in code.

features.title: Detection with proven engines
features.body: Scanning with recognized open-source engines, always in safe mode: detection yes, intrusion never.

features.title: Live threat intelligence
features.body: Every finding is joined with the official vulnerability and known-exploited catalogs, so you know what's genuinely urgent.

features.title: AI prioritization
features.body: AI triages findings, flags false positives, and drafts plain-language remediation plans — every analysis is audited.

features.title: Full remediation lifecycle
features.body: From open to verified, with confirmation rescans, time-to-remediate metrics, and risk acceptances that expire.

features.title: Audit-ready reports
features.body: Executive, technical, and PCI and SOC 2 evidence reports generated with AI, exportable to PDF.

built.title: Defensive security with iron guardrails.
built.body: Allowlisted authorized scope enforced default-deny, safe mode forced in code, server-side RBAC, MFA, an immutable audit log, and a hardened containerized deployment — backed by 200+ automated tests.

privacy.title: Personal data processing policy
privacy.lead: This policy explains how Novieri collects, uses, stores, and protects the personal data it receives through this website and its business operation, in compliance with Colombian Law 1581 of 2012, Decree 1074 of 2015, and the instructions of the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce.

p: The controller of your personal data is {company}, a company domiciled in Barranquilla, Atlántico, Colombia[[, with tax ID (NIT) {nit}]].
For any matter related to this policy, including exercising your rights as a data subject, write to {email}. This is the official channel for data subject requests.

This policy is governed by the Political Constitution of Colombia (article 15), Statutory Law 1581 of 2012, Single Regulatory Decree 1074 of 2015 (which compiled Decree 1377 of 2013), and the circulars and instructions of the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce, Colombia's data protection authority.
We only collect the data we need to handle your request. Depending on how you interact with us, this may include:
ul: Identification and contact data: name, email address, company, and role, when you complete the contact form or book a call.
The content of your communications: the message you send us, the service you're interested in, and your conversations with the website assistant.
Technical browsing data: IP address, device and browser type, pages visited, and aggregate usage data, for statistical and security purposes.
Data arising from a commercial relationship: billing and operational contact information, once we reach a services agreement.
p2: We do not collect sensitive data (racial or ethnic origin, political views, religious beliefs, union membership, health data, sexual life, or biometric data) through this website. We also do not request data from children or adolescents. If you believe a minor has sent us personal data, write to us and we will delete it.

p: We process your personal data for the following purposes:
ul: Responding to your questions and requests for commercial information.
Preparing and sending service proposals and quotes, and scheduling meetings.
Delivering, administering, and invoicing contracted services.
Providing technical support and sending you relevant operational information about the services.
Sending you commercial communications about our services where you have authorized it; you may withdraw that authorization at any time.
Keeping the site secure, preventing fraud and abuse, and maintaining internal and accounting records.
Complying with legal, accounting, and tax obligations and with requests from competent authorities.
p2: We do not use your data for purposes other than those stated, and we do not make automated decisions that produce legal effects on you.

p: By submitting the contact form, writing to us by email or WhatsApp, or chatting with the website assistant, you give prior, express, and informed authorization for the processing of your personal data in accordance with this policy.

Authorization to receive commercial communications is optional and separable: you may decline it and still have your request handled. We keep evidence of the authorization granted, as required by law.

sections.h: 6. Your rights as a data subject
p: As the owner of the personal data, Colombian law grants you the following rights:
ul: To access, update, and rectify your personal data held by Novieri.
To request proof of the authorization you granted, except where the law does not require it.
To be informed, upon request, about how we have used your data.
To file complaints with the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce for breaches of data protection rules.
To revoke your authorization and/or request deletion of your data, where no legal or contractual duty requires us to keep it.
To access your personal data free of charge.

p: You may exercise your rights by writing to {email} from an address that identifies you, stating your name, a description of your request, and any supporting documents.

We answer queries within a maximum of ten (10) business days, extendable by five (5) further business days when they cannot be resolved in that time, informing you of the reasons and the date of resolution.

Complaints are handled within a maximum of fifteen (15) business days, extendable by eight (8) further business days, following the procedure in article 15 of Law 1581 of 2012. If a complaint is incomplete, we will ask you for the missing information within five (5) days of receiving it.

To run the website and deliver our services we use technology providers that may act as data processors and be located outside Colombia, including: web hosting and email, productivity and storage tools, online meeting scheduling, website analytics, and the AI model provider behind the website assistant.

Where such international transfers or transmissions occur, we require our providers to apply security and confidentiality standards equivalent to those in this policy, through data transmission agreements or contractual protection obligations, in accordance with articles 25 and 26 of Law 1581 of 2012.
We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data with third parties.
The site offers a virtual assistant that answers questions about Novieri. The content of the conversation is sent to our AI model provider solely to generate the reply.

Please do not enter sensitive data, credentials, third-party confidential information, or personal data that isn't necessary for your question. If you need to discuss something confidential, write to {email}.

We apply reasonable technical, human, and administrative measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration, or misuse: encryption in transit, role-based access control, activity logging, and periodic review of our providers.

We retain your data while a commercial relationship or an active purpose exists, and afterwards for as long as needed to meet legal, accounting, and tax obligations. Once those periods lapse, we delete or anonymize it.

This policy applies from the date of its last update and remains in force for as long as Novieri processes personal data. Any substantial change will be published on this page; we recommend reviewing it periodically.
Databases are kept for as long as the processing purposes and applicable legal duties remain in force.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.lead: This policy explains what cookies and similar technologies are, which ones novieri.com uses, what they are for, and how you can accept them, reject them, or change your mind at any time.

p: A cookie is a small text file that a website stores in your browser to remember information between visits. Alongside cookies there are similar technologies, such as browser local storage, that serve comparable purposes.
In this policy we use the word “cookies” to refer to all of those technologies.
In Colombia, setting cookies that process personal data requires the data subject's prior, express, and informed consent, under Law 1581 of 2012 and Decree 1074 of 2015.

That's why, the first time you visit the site, we show a notice where you can accept or reject cookies that are not strictly necessary. Until you accept, we do not activate analytics or measurement technologies. Strictly necessary cookies do not require consent because the site cannot work without them.
We keep the site deliberately light. These are the categories we apply:
ul: Strictly necessary: we store your cookie decision in your browser's local storage (key “novieri-consent”) so we don't ask again on every visit. It does not identify individuals and is not shared with third parties.

Analytics and measurement: if you accept them, we activate a web analytics tool that tells us how many people visit the site and which pages they read, in aggregate. We use it to improve the content, not to profile people.

CRM and attribution (HubSpot): if you accept, we load HubSpot's script, which sets the __hstc, hubspotutk, __hssc, and __hssrc cookies. They recognise your browser between visits and link the form you submit to the pages you read beforehand, so we know which content was useful. If you reject them, the forms still work — they simply arrive without that history.
Third-party functional: when you open meeting scheduling or the WhatsApp chat, the relevant provider may set its own cookies in your browser, subject to its policies.
Advertising: we do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

p: You can change your choice at any time by clearing this site's data in your browser: the next time you visit, the notice will appear again and you can decide anew.

You can also configure your browser to block or delete cookies. Note that blocking strictly necessary ones may affect how the site works. The major browsers explain how to do this in their privacy help pages.

When you use features provided by third parties — meeting scheduling, WhatsApp, or embedded content — those providers act as controllers of the cookies they set and of the processing they carry out. We recommend reviewing their respective privacy and cookie policies.
Where a cookie processes personal data, our personal data processing policy also applies, including your rights as a data subject and the channels to exercise them.
If you have questions about this policy, write to {email}.
